observations: A portable electronic keyboard with 'YAMAHA' logo visible in all three photos (photo 0, 1, 2).
Keyboard has narrower/shorter keys typical of a compact home keyboard, not a full 88-key weighted stage piano.
Visible control panel with colored instrument/rhythm selection charts, a small LCD display, and buttons (photo 0, 1, 2).
Keys show yellowing and surface wear consistent with age/used condition (photo 2).
No power adapter, power cord, or stand visible in any photo.
No photo shows the unit powered on, display lit, or any indication of sound output.
Keyboard is balanced on a red plastic chair, not a proper stand or stage setup.
A watermark 'LUCKY SOUNDS SERVICES LTD' overlays photos 1 and 2, suggesting a reseller/dealer listing rather than a direct owner photo.

claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show a compact, light-duty home/portable keyboard with small keys and a basic demo-song panel, a format associated with entry-level models, not professional stage keyboards.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may have non-functional keys/buttons
risks.proof: A video clip of the keyboard powering on, display lighting up, and a few keys being pressed with audible sound

risks.risk: Missing power adapter required to operate the keyboard
risks.proof: A photo of the adapter/cord included in the sale
risks.if_unproven: priced as not included, buyer must source separately

risks.risk: Exact model unknown, which affects feature set and resale value
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model number sticker (usually on the back or near the battery compartment)

risks.risk: Speaker or audio output may be damaged (common in used keyboards)
risks.proof: A video clip with sound demonstrating playback through built-in speakers

risks.risk: Physical damage to keys (yellowing could indicate age, but cracks/breaks not ruled out)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of full key bed from both ends
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic wear with possible key damage

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the model number label (back or underside of keyboard)
Video clip of the keyboard powered on with sound playing
Photo confirming power adapter is included
Full-length photo of the keyboard off the chair, on a flat surface, showing all keys
response.reason: Brand (Yamaha) and item type (portable keyboard) are visually confirmed, but no power-on, model number, or adapter is shown, and the 'professional' claim is contradicted by the compact home-keyboard form factor, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, untested entry-level used unit.
